messages:
Ivy Park: Quick idea: run a micro-workshop series (20m live + 10m Q&A) that ties to a tiny prompt-template fork + follow-up nudges. goal: move attendees from curious -> 5-request "aha" -> paid trial. tracking + routing thoughts below.
Marcus Lee: nice. how are we gating access? RSVP only, or RSVP + small credit claim?
Ivy Park: RSVP + instant 30-token claim on confirmation page. but also expose a non-claim "try-inline" demo for anonymous visitors. measure delta.
Sana Iqbal: routing: enterprise domains -> SF lead + tag "microworkshop-2026". others -> growth inbox. if user redeems >100 tokens -> create SDR task.
Theo Burns: analytics: create events:
```nmicroworkshop_rsvp
microworkshop_claim_30t
inline_demo_try
prompt_fork_installed
first_5_requests
followup_clicks
```
Also campaign property: "microws-series-apr"
Marcus Lee: creative: need 1 landing page, 1 confirmation modal, 3 email variants (pre, day-of, follow-up), and 2 short demo clips (10s). can design ship in 48h?
Ivy Park: yes. split tests: CTA language ("Try in 5 requests" vs "Build your first assistant"). run CTA test on the landing page.
Sana Iqbal: measuring primary: % reach first_5 within 72h post-workshop. secondary: 14-day paid conversion. Also capture avg tokens consumed and model latency during demo flows.
Theo Burns: ops: can we enable a temporary model-tier fastpath for confirmation-page claim and live attendees? want <200ms median for demo requests.
Marcus Lee: tagging eng-ml. if not possible, at least ring-fence capacity from Dedicated pool for first 48h.
notify-bot: reminder: feature flag "microws_fastpath" created, default off.
Ivy Park: follow-up nurture plan: 1) immediate thank-you email with prompt-fork + 30 tokens, 2) 24h nudge showing 3 starter prompts, 3) 72h "need help" invite to office hours. each step has a CTA that either opens the in-app promptpack or schedules a 1:1.
Sana Iqbal: routing nuance: if user clicks "schedule 1:1" and email domain enterprise -> create SF event and assign to solutions rep, else -> route to growth and offer office hours.
Theo Burns: tracking nuance: we should set an "anon_cookie_id" on inline demo runs so when they later claim tokens we can map cross-device. add that property to demo events.
Marcus Lee: cost calc: token cost estimate 0.00075 USD/token; plan for worst-case 30% redemption of claims. include infra uplift of 10% in benchmark.
Ivy Park: post-launch benchmark doc: include hypothesis, cohort size, channels, funnel metrics (rsvp->claim->first_5->paid), token economics, latency/cost per request, creative variants performance, and recommended next step. also short appendix: promptpack contents + starter tasks.
Sana Iqbal: timeline: assets Tue noon, flag enable Wed AM, soft launch Wed 10am PT to 3k seeded users, run 7 days, postmortem 1 week after.
Marcus Lee: small control: run an arm with RSVP + NO credits to measure native RSVP -> first_5.
Ivy Park: yes. randomize 3 arms: control (no credit), RSVP+30t claim, RSVP+inline-demo-first then claim on follow-up.
notify-bot: scheduled: postmortem reminder set for 2026-04-20.
Theo Burns: I'll build the funnel dashboard and include per-arm token spend + median latency. ETA Fri.
Ivy Park: final ask: add an in-app coach tooltip that surfaces the promptpack after install. growth thinks this will nudge to first_5. Ops/Eng can we add as a short-lived UX flag?
Theo Burns: will create UX-flag ticket.
Sana Iqbal: locking plan. posting checklist to #marketing-prod now. thanks team! :sparkles:
